# dsh-classic-tools

Web search for local models and help for small context windows, for
DeepSeek Harness (DSH):

*tool budget** and a **scratchpad** that keep small-context models (about 49k tokens or
less) on tra

ck;
- two light modes, **Ultralight** and **Advanced thinking**.
> **Maintenance: best-effort.** Issues may go unanswered; forks are welcome.
## What it adds
### Web chip and `/web`

- `/web on | off | toggle | status`, or click the **Web** chip in the message box. One switch for
ev

ery conversation and every model, applied from the next message. The state is kept in
`<DSH_HOME>/we

b-toggle.json`. **Web starts OFF** until you turn it on.
- OFF: the web tools are hidden from the mo

del, so it never calls a dead tool.
- ON:
- DSH itself searches the web for each new message of your

s (not left to the model's choice) and
adds the results before the model answers. Greetings, panel p

assages and questions about
your own notes ("my notes", "in my Logseq") are not searched.
- Short re

search rules are added to the system prompt: answer from pages read, mark single-source
facts "(unco

nfirmed)", end with a **Sources** section.
- If the answer has no Sources section, the model is sent

back once to add it.
- `web_search` and `web_fetch` go through Ollama. `web_fetch` is replaced by *

*`web_read`**
(below).
### `web_read`
DSH's `web_fetch` returns the start of a page. `web_read(url, question?, start?)` instead cleans the

page (CSS and script leftovers, menus, repeated paragraphs, link targets), saves it in
`<DSH_HOME>/

cache/web`, splits it at headings, ranks the passages against the question with
BM25 (keyword scorin

g, no model) and returns the best ones, about 4000 characters, in page order.
The model can read oth

er parts with another question or `start=p7`. A saved page is reused for 24 h
and deleted after 3 da

parts with another question or `start=p7`. A saved page is reused for 24 h
and deleted after 3 days.
### Tool budget
On an agent whose context window is 49152 tokens or less (`maxContextWindow`), each family of tools

stays hidden until your messages mention it, and then stays available for the conversation. Larger
m

odels keep every tool. A family is `{ id, tools: [tool names], words: "regular expression" }`. The
d
efaults name the tools of the author's other plugins (Zotero, Logseq, documents, memory, tasks...);
tools that are not installed are skipped. Replace them in `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Scratchpad

For the same small-context models: tools `step_done(step, learned)`, `scratch_note(text)`,
`scratch_

read(name?)`. Notes are kept in `<DSH_HOME>/scratch/<conversation>/` (`state.md` ledger,
`steps/NN.m

d`, `notes.md`, `raw/` = full text of folded outputs, `synthese.md` = final answer). After
a `step_d

one`, long tool outputs (over 600 characters) are folded at the next step to a short head and
a poin

ter, the same replay-safe way as DSH's own tool-result pruner (the original stays in the
session log

). The protocol and the ledger are re-sent with every request, so they survive
compaction. If you as

k for the results in a folder ("save it in ~/reports"), a step that says it
wrote elsewhere is refus

ed. Folders untouched for 7 days are removed at startup. Larger models do
not see these tools. The i

dea follows AgentFold and Context-Folding (2025), MemGPT's core memory and
Anthropic's memory tool.
### Ultralight and Advanced thinking

Two agent modes with the smallest possible prompt for small models: no shell, no file changes, web
t

ools only while the Web chip is ON. Ultralight answers concisely; Advanced thinking asks for
step-by
-step reasoning with self-checking (set Effort to "high" in the model menu).
The interface is in English, and in French when DSH's language is French. To translate the chip, add
a table next to `en` and `fr` at the top of `client.js`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the profile afterwards. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` (see

Compatibility), and an Ollama that can answer web search and fetch requests (see
Permissions). Once

the package is on npm,
`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-classic-tools` works too.
## Configuration
Everything has a default. Edit the rows in `cordis.patch.yml` (or your profile) to change:
| Row | Option | Default | Meaning |
| `web-toggle` | `skipSkills` | `[]` | slash commands (names without `/`) that work only on your own

text: a message using one gets no automatic search, for example `[summarize, translate]` |
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

- `lib/web-toggle.js` (host side) registers the Ollama providers, `/web`, the `web_read` tool, the
r

esearch rules and the hooks; its pure rules are in `lib/web-rules.js` (search query, Sources
detecti

on, turn state).
- `lib/web-page.js` is the `web_read` engine: cleaning, passages, BM25, cache. Pure

JavaScript, no
dependency. It is a port of native code; the port was compared with that code on abo

ut 140,000
generated, fixture and real-page cases (cleaned text, chosen passages and cache files) wi

th
identical results.
- `lib/tool-budget.js`, `lib/scratchpad.js` and `lib/scratch-core.js` (pure fu

nctions) hold the
small-context helpers.
- `client.js` (page side) draws the chip. It reads the stat

e from the description of the `/web`
command ("... - currently ON"), so showing the state leaves no

line in the conversation (a click
runs `/web on` or `/web off`, which shows one short line).
- `cord

is.patch.yml` adds the rows, the two modes and the `web` provider choice
(`searchProvider: ollama`,
`fetchProvider: ollama`). Removing the bundle removes all of it.
## Compatibility
| Component | Supported |
ptional `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `zod`, the only p

ackages loaded from the DSH installation |
| Platform | Linux (tested); pure JavaScript, no native a

ddon |
| Ollama | a version that serves `/api/experimental/web_search` and `/api/experimental/web_fe
tch` (experimental endpoints that may change) |
Tested with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` on Node 22.23 (see Verification).
